themes.quote: We are continuing to build out our on-site business, with projects in our backlog that will support long-term contracted revenue growth
performance of all Linde Engineering agreements in Russia were lawfully suspended in compliance with applicable sanctions
RCA filed a similar claim for repayment and damages against Linde for alleged breach of contract under the agreement to build a liquefied natural gas plant in Russia
growth in merchant gases across all regions supported by market demand recovery and operational efficiency improvements
Customers that require the largest volumes of product and that have a relatively constant demand pattern are supplied by cryogenic and process gas on-site plants
Linde is responsible for the design, construction, operations and maintenance of the plants and our customers typically have no involvement in these activities
On-site product supply contracts generally are total requirement contracts with terms typically ranging from 10 - 20 years and contain minimum purchase requirements and price escalation provisions
Linde serves a diverse group of industries including healthcare, chemicals and energy, manufacturing, metals and mining, food and beverage, and electronics
continue to grow on-site hydrogen capacity to serve refining, chemicals and other industrial customers
increase market share in our merchant gases business across geographies
our Engineering segment backlog remains healthy with significant customer interest in large-scale projects
significant capital expenditures to build out industrial gas infrastructure and generation capacity
